record.question: All the following are causes of intruterine growth retardation
record.explanation: Checked the printed page 4 (Q28) of the Jan-2017 MPSC paper: the stem reads 'All the following are causes of intruterine growth retardation' with no 'except' and no 'all of the above' option, so the item is defective as printed; the only defensible single answer is the exception. Anemia, pregnancy-induced hypertension (placental insufficiency) and maternal heart disease (chronic hypoxaemia/poor uteroplacental perfusion) are all recognised causes of IUGR, whereas gestational diabetes characteristically causes fetal macrosomia rather than growth restriction (growth restriction with diabetes relates to pregestational disease with vasculopathy). Confidence is low only because the printed stem appears truncated of the word 'except'.
